data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Anoop Gadhrri, Sohaib Al-Emara, and Reiner Schmidt, having raised C$12M to date. The target operates within a sector represented by nine peer companies (one public, eight private), including players such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation proved inapplicable. The Robotics & Manufacturing peer set contains ten same-sector companies but lacks sufficient depth at identical or adjacent stages to support a credible median comparable. Stage-progression applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $30M on the $12M total-raised proxy base. This method produces an implied valuation of $30M.

The quantitative analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. The single applicable method limits confidence in this conclusion; reliance on stage-progression rather than peer benchmarking introduces model risk. Key uncertainties center on the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company and sector, capital efficiency relative to peers, and timing to Series A. Broader peer comparables at the Seed and early growth stages would materially improve conviction in any final valuation recommendation.
